title: UE Blueprint Graph Organize
description: Plan, apply, and verify an atomic deterministic UE 5.3-compatible Blueprint Graph layout edit with structural and visual evidence.

recipes.title: Organize and verify one Blueprint Graph
recipes.description: Preview a bounded layout, apply the exact approved plan in one Workflow transaction, and verify structure, geometry, and pixels.

inputs.name: blueprint
inputs.description: Blueprint asset path containing the target graph.

inputs.name: groups
inputs.description: Disjoint node groups and their ordered layout actions.

steps.purpose: Read exact Graph Editor geometry, retain the structural baseline, and capture the unchanged view.

Run deterministic UE 5.3-compatible layout semantics on an exact transient graph, cross-check all Graph obstacles, and review the prediction-bound digest without changing the asset, selection, dirty state, or Undo stack.
Rebuild the exact transient prediction, verify its approved digest and graph hash, then apply the approved coordinates and native Comment bounds in the existing Workflow transaction.
Verify graph identity, connections, exact layout diagnostics, compile validity, and dirty state.
Capture the same Graph Editor and compare compatible render fingerprints and changed pixels.
